# UseSuno MV Studio

> UseSuno MV Studio is an open-source, local-first web application for creating animated lyric videos and music visualizers from Suno AI music and audio tracks. Everything runs directly in the browser with 100% privacy, WebCodecs hardware acceleration, and no cloud uploads.

## Overview
UseSuno MV Studio transforms audio tracks and lyrics into music videos. It features 20+ visualizer templates (including Apple Music-style kinetic typography, artistic 3D scenes, Chinese calligraphy, and modern shaders), custom media backgrounds with video trimming, precision word-by-word lyric sync, and transparent lyric animation export (WebM VP9 Alpha) for post-production video editing in Premiere, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut.

## Key Capabilities
- **20+ Visualizer Templates**: Fume, Classic, Cadenza, Partita, Tilt, Claddagh, Monet, Cappella, Diorama, Aurora Traverse, Pendolo, Tempera, Sonnet, Still, Astral (星轨), Kyoto (京调), Chroma (丹青), Elysium (灵境), Syzygy (朔望), and Lumiere (绘光).
- **Apple Music Style Kinetic Lyrics**: Fluid, glowing, synchronized word-by-word and line-by-line lyric animations with dynamic focus and blur.
- **Transparent Lyric Video Layer Export**: Export transparent alpha-channel video (WebM VP9 with 32-bit RGBA) while preserving synchronized audio, allowing creators to overlay animated lyrics onto custom video projects in editing software.
- **Custom Backgrounds & Trimming**: Support for custom videos (with built-in clip trimming), animated GIFs, images, and generative WebGL/Canvas backgrounds (Fluid Light, Theme Space, Aurora Nebula, Light Tide, Starlight).
- **Precision Lyric Timing Workspace**: Dedicated timing interface for word-level and line-level synchronization via keyboard tapping, supporting LRC, TTML, and embedded metadata extraction.
- **Multi-aspect Ratios**: 16:9 (landscape/desktop), 9:16 (vertical/TikTok/Shorts/Reels), and 1:1 (square/Instagram).
- **High-resolution Video Export**: 720p and 1080p up to 60fps, supporting frame-by-frame hardware-accelerated WebCodecs export and real-time MediaRecorder recording.
- **Local-first & Privacy Focused**: 100% client-side execution; audio, video, and lyric data never leave the user's browser.
- **11 Languages Supported**: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Indonesian, Hindi, Brazilian Portuguese, Filipino, German, Urdu, Russian, and Vietnamese.

## Documentation & Links
- [Main Application](https://usesuno.com/): Interactive browser studio to create and export lyric videos.
- [Lyrics Timing Editor](https://usesuno.com/timestamp.html): Dedicated workspace for word-by-word and line-by-line lyric synchronization.
- [Full LLM Documentation](https://usesuno.com/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive technical specifications, template list, export formats, and guide.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/UseSuno/UseSunoMVStudio): Source code, AGPL-3.0 license, and issue tracking.
- [User Guide](https://usesuno.com/articles/how-to-use-usesuno-mv-studio/): Step-by-step user walkthrough and tutorials.
- [Privacy Policy](https://usesuno.com/privacy.html): Local data handling and privacy guarantee.
- [Open Source Licenses](https://usesuno.com/licenses.html): AGPL-3.0 and third-party notices.
